query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
              FROM (
                SELECT cm.userid
                  FROM channelmembers cm
                  JOIN users u ON cm.userid = u.id
                  JOIN channels c ON cm.channelid = c.id
                 WHERE u.roles ILIKE '%system_guest%'
                   AND u.deleteat = 0
                   AND c.deleteat = 0
                   AND c.type IN ('O', 'P')
                 GROUP BY cm.userid
                HAVING COUNT(cm.channelid) = 1
              ) AS single_channel_guests
